Teburin aika kaya — rajista, lakabi, miƙa, kammala lissafi.
Tsarin gidan abinci — tebur, kicin, lissafi, rufe yini.
Teburin kayan masarufi — sayarwa, littafin bashi, haja, littafin yini.
Teburin kantin magani — rukuni, ƙarewa, lissafi, rufe yini.

Intanet a kashe — kuma babu abin da ya canza a teburin ciniki.
Kowane samfurin Kumkaj yana da asusunsa (da gajimarensa). Zaɓi sana’ar da kuke gudanarwa — shiga da biya suna zama a shafin wannan samfurin.

Tsare-tsaren gajimare na shekara — siffofi biyar iri ɗaya ga kowace sana’a (Kyauta har abada, Steady ₹6,000, Swift ₹12,000, Priority ₹24,000 / shekara ba haraji, ko ƙiyasin farashi na musamman). Ana ƙara haraji wajen biya. Kowane samfuri yana riƙe da shagonsa da asusunsa.
